summary.text: Scott Cyrway is a Republican state senator from Albion, Maine, who has represented Senate District 16 since December 2024 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. A law enforcement officer, he previously served in the Senate from 2014 to 2022.

paragraphs.text: Cyrway lives in Albion, Maine, graduated from Lawrence High School in 1973 and earned an associate degree from the University of Maine in 1976.

His career experience includes working as a deputy sheriff with the Kennebec County Sheriff's Office, a tobacco compliance agent with Howe, Cahill, and Company, and a mentor and core curriculum instructor with D.A.R.E. America International.
Cyrway represented Maine Senate District 16 from 2014 to 2022 and Maine House District 63 from 2022 to 2024, and returned to Senate District 16 on December 3, 2024, succeeding David LaFountain.
For 2025 and 2026 he was assigned to the Criminal Justice and Public Safety Committee and the Bills in Second Reading Committee.
He advanced from the Republican primary on June 9, 2026.
